custom_commands:
set -euo pipefail
# 1) Clave de firma de CachyOS
pacman-key --recv-keys F3B607488DB35A47 --keyserver keyserver.ubuntu.com
pacman-key --lsign-key F3B607488DB35A47
cp -a /etc/pacman.conf /etc/pacman.conf.pre-cachyos
# 2) Repo temporal SOLO para traer keyring + mirrorlists (sin versiones fijadas)
cat >> /etc/pacman.conf <<'EOF'

[cachyos]
SigLevel = Optional TrustAll
Server = https://mirror.cachyos.org/repo/$arch/$repo
EOF
pacman -Sy --noconfirm cachyos-keyring cachyos-mirrorlist cachyos-v3-mirrorlist
# 3) pacman.conf definitivo: repos x86-64-v3 (Arrow Lake NO tiene AVX-512 -> v4 no aplica)
cp -a /etc/pacman.conf.pre-cachyos /etc/pacman.conf
awk '/^\[core\]/ && !done {
  print "[cachyos-v3]\nInclude = /etc/pacman.d/cachyos-v3-mirrorlist\n"
  print "[cachyos-core-v3]\nInclude = /etc/pacman.d/cachyos-v3-mirrorlist\n"
  print "[cachyos-extra-v3]\nInclude = /etc/pacman.d/cachyos-v3-mirrorlist\n"
  print "[cachyos]\nInclude = /etc/pacman.d/cachyos-mirrorlist\n"
  done=1 } { print }' /etc/pacman.conf.pre-cachyos > /etc/pacman.conf
sed -i 's/^#\?Architecture = .*/Architecture = x86_64 x86_64_v3/' /etc/pacman.conf
pacman -Syu --noconfirm
pacman -Si linux-cachyos >/dev/null
set -euo pipefail
pacman -S --noconfirm --needed linux-cachyos
test -f /boot/vmlinuz-linux-cachyos
test -f /boot/initramfs-linux-cachyos.img
# Entrada systemd-boot derivada de la que genero archinstall para el kernel "linux"
src=""
for f in /boot/loader/entries/*_linux.conf; do src="$f"; break; done
test -f "$src"
sed -e 's|^title .*|title   LarryOS (linux-cachyos)|' \
    -e 's|/vmlinuz-linux$|/vmlinuz-linux-cachyos|' \
    -e 's|/initramfs-linux\.img|/initramfs-linux-cachyos.img|' \
    "$src" > /boot/loader/entries/larryos-cachyos.conf
if grep -q '^default' /boot/loader/loader.conf; then
  sed -i 's|^default .*|default larryos-cachyos.conf|' /boot/loader/loader.conf
else
  echo 'default larryos-cachyos.conf' >> /boot/loader/loader.conf
fi
grep -q '^timeout' /boot/loader/loader.conf || echo 'timeout 3' >> /boot/loader/loader.conf
set -euo pipefail
# archinstall instala siempre el metapaquete linux-firmware (arrastra amd, amdgpu, nvidia, radeon...).
# Lo sustituimos por los sub-paquetes que el hardware REAL de este portatil necesita.
keep="linux-firmware-intel"   # iGPU (GuC/HuC), NPU (intel/vpu), Bluetooth/Wi-Fi Intel, microcodigo de red
pci_vendor() { local d; for d in /sys/bus/pci/devices/*; do
  if [ -f "$d/class" ] && [ "$(cut -c1-6 "$d/class")" = "$1" ]; then cat "$d/vendor"; fi; done; return 0; }
usb_bt_vendor() { local d; for d in /sys/bus/usb/devices/*; do
  if [ -f "$d/bDeviceClass" ] && [ "$(cat "$d/bDeviceClass")" = "e0" ]; then cat "$d/idVendor"; fi; done; return 0; }
vendors="$(pci_vendor 0x0280) $(usb_bt_vendor)"   # 0x0280 = controlador de red inalambrico
known=0
for v in $vendors; do case "$v" in
  0x8086|8087) known=1 ;;
  0x10ec|0bda) keep="$keep linux-firmware-realtek"; known=1 ;;
  0x14c3|0e8d) keep="$keep linux-firmware-mediatek"; known=1 ;;
  0x168c|0cf3) keep="$keep linux-firmware-atheros"; known=1 ;;
  0x14e4)      keep="$keep linux-firmware-broadcom"; known=1 ;;
esac; done
# Si no se identifica el chip Wi-Fi/BT, NO se arriesga: se conservan los cuatro habituales
[ "$known" = 1 ] || keep="$keep linux-firmware-realtek linux-firmware-mediatek linux-firmware-atheros linux-firmware-broadcom"
# Amplificadores Cirrus (CSC3551/CSC3556 en ACPI) usados por algunos portatiles Lenovo
if compgen -G '/sys/bus/acpi/devices/CSC35*' >/dev/null; then keep="$keep linux-firmware-cirrus"; fi
keep=$(printf '%s\n' $keep | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')
echo "LarryOS: firmware conservado -> $keep"
all="amd amdgpu atheros broadcom cirrus intel mediatek nvidia other radeon realtek ti"
drop=""
for p in $all; do case " $keep " in *" linux-firmware-$p "*) ;; *) drop="$drop linux-firmware-$p";; esac; done
pacman -D --asexplicit $keep
pacman -Rdd --noconfirm linux-firmware $drop
pacman -Qq linux-firmware 2>/dev/null && { echo "linux-firmware sigue instalado" >&2; exit 1; } || true
